finalText:
Build is clean now — exit 0, 0 errors. There were two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries` (undefined), so `.toFixed(0)` threw. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Added an `undefined` → `false` case.

The remaining 8 `WARN DEP...`/`WARN W...` lines are genuine deprecation noise from the dependency bump (unrelated APIs like `fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, plus a couple of app-level lint-style warnings) — not build blockers, so I left those as-is. Let me know if you want those cleaned up too.
